decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Azusa, Cultivator Colossus, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. This allows the player to play multiple lands each turn and efficiently ramp into Primeval Titan. The deck also utilizes Amulet of Vigor to untap lands when they enter the battlefield, further accelerating mana production. With the mana generated, the player can search for specific lands using Summoner's Pact and Expedition Map, and eventually assemble powerful land combinations like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Castle Garenbrig to deal massive amounts of damage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to combo off with Leyline Binding to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also includes cards like Prismari Command and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Wrenn and Six provide additional value by recurring lands and spells from the graveyard. The mana base is optimized for quick and efficient mana fixing to ensure the combo pieces can be played in a timely manner.

This deck focuses on quickly casting cheap spells to trigger cascade effects, allowing you to cast powerful spells for free. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a barrage of creatures and spells, utilizing the cascade mechanic to keep the pressure on. By combining aggressive creatures with cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, you can quickly flood the board and push for a fast victory. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation to disrupt your opponent's game plan and Leyline Binding to lock down threats on the board.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain control of the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up a strong board presence. The deck utilizes a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the flow of the game. It also focuses on equipment and powerful creatures to provide threats on the battlefield. The deck aims to efficiently answer the opponent's threats while establishing its own, and ultimately outvalue the opponent over time.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using a combination of efficient removal spells and powerful creatures. By using a multicolored mana base, the deck is able to consistently cast powerful spells like Tribal Flames and Bloodbraid Elf. With a mix of direct damage spells and high-impact creatures like Geist of Saint Traft and Scion of Draco, the deck aims to apply pressure early and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Growth Spiral and Sakura-Tribe Elder, while controlling the game with counter spells like Remand and Counterspell. The ultimate goal is to play Scapeshift to bring out multiple Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle along with lands to deal a large amount of damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Expressive Iteration to help fix mana and draw into key pieces. The deck aims to control the game until it can pull off the Scapeshift combo for a powerful win condition.

This UR Aggro deck is focused on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes card draw and selection with spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. Counterspells are used to protect your threats and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to both red and blue mana sources. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control throughout the game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to keep the opponent off balance. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Consider and Expressive Iteration to maintain momentum. The land base is designed to ensure consistent mana production for quick and decisive plays. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of early pressure and versatile disruption.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly take down the opponent's life total. By utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Territorial Kavu, and Scion of Draco, along with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and end the game as quickly as possible. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional level of consistency to the deck's mana base. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and quick, decisive plays.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and efficient spells to rapidly deal damage to the opponent, aiming to win the game quickly through a combination of creature attacks and direct damage. The deck includes diverse mana sources to support the deck's multicolor nature and utilizes a companion for additional synergy. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to apply early pressure and maintain control of the board, forcing the opponent to react defensively or risk being overwhelmed by the aggressive onslaught.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to turn tokens created by Dwarven Mine into powerful threats like Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Persist to create a loop with recursion cards like Wrenn and Six. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal like Lightning Bolt, while also digging for combo pieces with cards like Bitter Reunion and Prismari Command. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent while assembling the combo pieces needed to win the game in a creative and unconventional way.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin combo to equip a creature with a massive power boost and go on the offensive. Cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift help search for equipment pieces, while Urza's Saga provides additional card advantage and ramp. Giver of Runes and Shadowspear offer protection and evasion, making it difficult for opponents to block or remove your creature. This deck aims to be aggressive and end the game swiftly with a powerful, unstoppable threat.

This deck focuses on quickly casting aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. It also includes versatile cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to help dig for more threats or answers. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Dress Down can give the deck an edge against certain strategies. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent access to both blue and red mana sources for casting spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays using efficient creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler alongside powerful removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and control the board. The deck also includes card draw and disruption with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Counterspell to maintain tempo and outpace the opponent. With a streamlined mana base and a focus on low-cost spells, the deck aims to win the game quickly through attacking and efficient removal.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Monastery Swiftspear, and Soul-Scar Mage to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing low-cost spells such as Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, along with card advantage engines like Light Up the Stage and Expressive Iteration, the deck aims to maintain a fast-paced tempo. The inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for recurring spells from the graveyard, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana consistency. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient spellcasting.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain aggressive pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to control the board by efficiently managing its resources and utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help dig for key cards, while Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide targeted removal. The deck's mana base allows for consistent casting of spells and enables flexible plays. Overall, the deck focuses on proactive aggression and reactive disruption to secure a victory.

This Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor, along with efficient removal spells like Supreme Verdict and Prismatic Ending to control the board and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes Counterspells and card draw spells like Archmage's Charm to maintain control of the game. Additionally, the inclusion of creatures like Solitude and Omnath, Locus of Creation provide additional threats and value. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using efficient removal spells to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional versatility in mana acceleration. The deck utilizes a mix of powerful multicolor spells and creatures to quickly pressure the opponent and maintain board presence. By balancing aggression with disruption, it aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's diverse color requirements and maximize consistency in casting spells.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Mishra's Bauble to repeatedly mill and re-cast cards from the graveyard, generating infinite mana and storm count to win the game. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Emry, Lurker of the Loch provide additional value and card advantage, while Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces while controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

Utilizing the combination of cards like Archon of Cruelty, Indomitable Creativity, and Persist to create powerful combos and disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck focuses on a creative approach to generating advantages and controlling the game through cards like Wrenn and Six, Thoughtseize, and Bitter Reunion. With a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, as well as a mana base that supports the combo strategy, the deck aims to surprise and overwhelm opponents with its unique interactions and synergy.

This deck revolves around equipping creatures with powerful equipment such as Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to create explosive, game-ending combos. The deck utilizes cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to search for and equip these powerful artifacts quickly and efficiently. By using cards like Giver of Runes and Sigarda's Aid for protection and support, this deck aims to create a board state where a well-equipped creature can deal massive amounts of damage in a single turn, overwhelming opponents and securing victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the Colossus Hammer combo as quickly as possible through the use of cheap artifacts like Memnite and Ornithopter, while also utilizing Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin for additional equipment support. Esper Sentinel provides card advantage, while Urza's Saga helps tutor for key pieces. The inclusion of Nettlecyst and Kaldra Compleat offer additional threats, and Inkmoth Nexus provides an alternate win condition. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a powerful, fast combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Colossus Hammer combo, using Puresteel Paladin to draw cards and equip for free. The deck aims to win by equipping Colossus Hammer to a creature, such as Gingerbrute or Ornithopter, and attacking for lethal damage in one swing. The deck also utilizes support cards like Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for equipment pieces and disrupt opponents with Spell Pierce. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key artifacts, while Giver of Runes protects important creatures. The deck's key strategy is to assemble the combo and win quickly.

This aggro Red Deck Wins deck focuses on fast and efficient burn spells and creatures to deal direct damage to the opponent and control the board. The inclusion of Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion enhances the deck's ability to deal extra damage. Key cards like Lightning Bolt, Blood Moon, and Bonecrusher Giant help maintain pressure on the opponent while Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage. The deck also utilizes lands like Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Den of the Bugbear to support its aggressive gameplay.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By using cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to put pressure on the opponent early, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and end it quickly. Additionally, cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional value by recurring from the graveyard, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize and come back from behind.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and remove threats. With cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Undying Malice, the deck has some graveyard synergy to bring back creatures for additional value. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Dauthi Voidwalker provide additional disruption and protection, making it difficult for the opponent to effectively respond to the aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler. It also utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for early pressure and disruption. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon can disrupt opposing mana bases, while cards like Mishra's Bauble provide card selection and graveyard synergies. With efficient threats and disruption, this deck aims to apply pressure quickly and maintain control of the game.

Mishra's Bauble and Consider allow for card selection and digging through the deck, while Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt provide removal and additional reach. The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It includes powerful control elements such as Karn Liberated and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also including threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to finish off the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Sylvan Scrying and Ancient Stirrings to find key pieces of the UrzaTron lands or threats, ensuring consistency in its game plan.

The main idea behind this deck is to control the board through counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers. By utilizing cards like Counterspell, Supreme Verdict, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the game. The inclusion of Chalice of the Void and Leyline Binding also helps in locking down the opponent's spells and permanents. With a focus on defensive cards and card advantage engines like Archmage's Charm and Jace, the Mind Sculptor, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually secure a victory through attrition.
